nozzle_note: 0.20mm in preset names is the LAYER HEIGHT (0.2mm); the nozzle is 0.4mm (see 0.20mm Standard @Anycubic Kobra S1 0.4 nozzle). The MCP slicer tools always resolve the 0.4 nozzle family.

notes: Sliced via slicer_multimaterial (CLI, not GUI) — write tools require confirm:true
Preset DISPLAY NAME includes a per-run hash suffix to avoid CLI cache reuse (fixed names silently reuse previous run's roles)
Switches are deterministic (role boundaries, never random)
To make exterior ALL beige and core marble, swap roles: outer_wall=2, inner_wall=1, infill=1, solid/top/bottom=2
